blockers.reason: The declarative adapter's strict text equality cannot establish that arbitrary complete summary wording semantically agrees with the displayed item set without inventing copy requirements.
blockers.recovery: After reviewed publication, use the authorized managed-browser observation lane to capture the full rendered summary and item names for concrete plural, singular, and empty states, interpret each complete meaning against the displayed count, store one agent_authored_unattested observation through the accepted writer, and read it back without promoting the campaign verdict.

blockers.reason: Inventory management belongs to a separate staff role, and this exercise supplies neither a staff account nor an authenticated staff surface.
blockers.recovery: Provide a separately authorized staff test surface and test identity, then design a role-scoped, non-production inventory check without weakening the public-catalog checks.

checks.expectedBehavior: For the rendered Apple, Pear, and Hammer witnesses, uppercase AMM is an internal substring of Hammer and therefore matches Hammer case-insensitively; selecting Fruit composes with that search and displays no items; clearing Search removes only the text restriction, leaves Fruit selected and visible, restores Apple and Pear, and excludes Hammer. No sorting order or summary copy is asserted.
preconditions: The owned loopback catalog is reachable at /catalog.
Rendered discovery shows Apple and Pear in Fruit, Hammer in Tools, and AMM only as a non-prefix substring of Hammer among those witnesses.
reproductionSteps: Open /catalog in a fresh public browser context.
Enter AMM in Search and inspect the internal, case-insensitive substring result.
Select Fruit without clearing Search and inspect the composed empty displayed set.
Clear Search and inspect that Fruit remains visible and selected while Apple and Pear return and Hammer remains excluded.
checks.severityJustification: Prefix-only search, broken filter composition, or lost category state prevents the catalog's primary visitor journey and can make valid inventory undiscoverable.
checks.title: Internal substring, category composition, and clear retain supported state

checks.expectedBehavior: The public Catalog surface keeps Search and Category visible. Selecting the rendered Tools category displays Hammer; entering a literal period while Tools remains selected displays no item because the rendered Hammer witness contains no period, so a pattern or wildcard interpretation of the period is rejected. No sorting order, summary copy, console-error rule, or overflow rule is asserted.
preconditions: The owned loopback catalog is reachable at /catalog.
Rendered discovery shows the Tools option value tools and Hammer as its witness item, with no period in that visible name.
reproductionSteps: Open /catalog in a fresh public browser context.
Select Tools and inspect that Hammer is displayed.
Enter a period in Search and inspect that the literal period is not treated as a pattern matching Hammer.
Inspect that Search and Category remain visible and Category remains tools.
checks.severityJustification: A broken category control or pattern interpretation in a promised literal search can return materially incorrect public results.
checks.title: Public controls stay visible and period search remains literal
